name: Cat Arch-Familiar
body:
CAT ARCH-FAMILIAR (FIGMENT)

Wizard 20
N Tiny magical beast
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +24

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 14, flat-footed 24 (+2 Dex, +12 natural, +2 size)
hp 49
Fort +5, Ref +8, Will +13
Defensive Abilities recurring dream; SR 25

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (good)
Melee 2 claws +14 (1d2–4), bite +14 (1d3–4)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th; concentration +30)

3/day–page-bound epiphany
1/day–legend lore

STATISTICS

Str 3, Dex 15, Con 8, Int 20, Wis 12, Cha 7
Base Atk +10; CMB +10; CMD 16 (20 vs. trip)
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +6, Climb +6, Diplomacy +18, Fly +14, Knowledge (arcana) +25, Knowledge (planes) +25, Perception +24, Sense Motive +21, Spellcraft +25, Stealth +14; Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Stealth
SQ empathic link, manifest dreams (flight, improved natural armor), share spells, speak with master

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Familiar

The master of a cat familiar gains a +3 bonus on Stealth checks.
